## COMPLETE UI STRUCTURE AUDIT - Candidate Detail Components

### 1. **CandidateDetailSheet.tsx** - Sheet Wrapper & Layout Container

**Visual Structure:**
- **Header Section:**
  - Candidate name (text-lg, truncated)
  - Location + email (text-xs, with MapPin icon)
- **Score Area:**
  - Overall Match percentage (text-2xl, font-semibold)
  - Strength badge (success/warning/destructive variants)
  - Quick badge (if heuristic scoring)
  - Vertical separator
- **Action Buttons Row:**
  - Call button (copies phone)
  - Email button (opens email dialog)
  - Resume button (downloads)
  - Archive button (delete icon)
- **Scrollable Content Area:**
  - Multiple panels stacked vertically with spacing
  - Gradient fade-out at bottom

**Styling Approach:**
- Uses `Sheet` from shadcn/ui with `sm:max-w-2xl` width
- Padding: `px-6 py-5` for scrollable content
- Spacing: `space-y-5` between major sections
- Button sizes: `h-8` with `text-xs`
- Icons: 3-3.5px sizes
- No Card wrappers in the sheet itself

---

### 2. **CandidateSummary.tsx** - Summary Display

**Visual Structure:**
- Label: "Summary" (text-xs, muted-foreground, font-medium)
- Summary text paragraph (text-sm, leading-relaxed)

**Styling Approach:**
- Simple text layout: `space-y-1`
- Text-xs for heading, text-sm for content
- No badges, no cards, minimal visual elements
- Clean, content-focused design

---

### 3. **StrengthsGapsPanel.tsx** - Strengths & Gaps

**Visual Structure:**
- 2-column grid (md:grid-cols-2)
- **Each Card:**
  - Header with title + count badge
  - List of items with colored dots (emerald for strengths, red for gaps)

**Styling Approach:**
- **Cards:** `Card`, `CardHeader`, `CardContent` with `pb-3`, `px-4`, `pt-4`
- **Heading:** text-sm font-medium
- **Badges:** `variant="secondary"`, `text-[11px]`, `h-5`
- **Item dots:** h-1.5 w-1.5, emerald-500 or red-500
- **Item text:** text-sm, leading-snug
- Spacing: `space-y-2` within cards

---

### 4. **SkillsDetailPanel.tsx** - Skills Breakdown

**Visual Structure:**
- **Card Header:** Title + skill count badge
- **Score Section:**
  - Large number (text-2xl, font-semibold)
  - Progress bar (h-1.5)
- **Top Skills:** Flex wrap badges with skill name + level
- **Gaps Section:** List with badge-based skill levels
- **Expand/Collapse:** Full skills list with toggle button
- **All Skills View:** Sortable list by score

**Styling Approach:**
- **Card:** Standard shadcn Card structure
- **Score number:** text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums
- **Badges:** 
  - Top skills: `variant="secondary"`, text-xs
  - Gaps: `variant="outline"`, text-[11px]
- **Progress:** h-1.5, custom bar
- **Expand button:** text-xs, ghost style, centered
- Spacing: `space-y-4` within CardContent

---

### 5. **JDAlignedPanel.tsx** - JD Alignment Panel

**Visual Structure:**
- **Header Row:**
  - Title + must-have match percentage
  - Recommendation badge + confidence badge
- **3-Column Grid:**
  - **Must Have Column:** Matched items (CheckCircle2, emerald) + Missing items (XCircle, red)
  - **Preferred Column:** Same layout as must-have
  - **AI Insight Column:** 
    - Why ranked here
    - Recommendation text
    - Interview focus (if available)
    - Key tradeoffs (if available)

**Styling Approach:**
- **Header:** flex-row, items-center, justify-between, flex-wrap, gap-3
- **Icons:** 
  - CheckCircle2: h-3.5 w-3.5, text-emerald-500
  - XCircle: h-3.5 w-3.5, text-red-400
- **Grid:** `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6`
- **Section headers:** text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground
- **Item text:** text-sm leading-snug
- **Badges:** Recommendation badge uses variant system (success/secondary/warning/destructive)
- Spacing: `space-y-3` within columns

---

### 6. **InterviewQuestionsPanel.tsx** - Interview Questions

**Visual Structure:**
- **Collapsible Card:**
  - Header with title, question count badge, chevron toggle
  - Expanded content: numbered list of questions
- Questions displayed with number + text

**Styling Approach:**
- **Card:** No CardHeader/CardContent - custom button layout
- **Button:** w-full, px-4 py-3, hover:bg-muted/50
- **Title:** text-sm font-medium
- **Badge:** text-[11px], h-5
- **Question number:** text-muted-foreground/50, font-medium, tabular-nums, w-5 text-right
- **Question text:** text-foreground/85, text-sm, leading-relaxed
- Spacing: question items have gap-3 flex layout

---

### 7. **ExperiencePanel.tsx** - Experience Timeline

**Visual Structure:**
- **Header with Icon + Title + Stat Pills:**
  - Briefcase icon in purple-500/10 background
  - Title: "Experience" uppercase
  - Right-aligned pills: Total duration, Full-time duration, Internship duration
- **Timeline Layout:**
  - Vertical timeline dots and connecting lines
  - Per role:
    - Title + Employment type badge
    - Company name (text-[11px])
    - Date range + Duration (emerald-600)
    - JD Relevance badge
  - Career gap indicators (amber background with dashed lines)
- **Footer:**
  - Role count + gap count
  - "See full detail" toggle button

**Styling Approach:**
- **Header Icon:** w-6 h-6, purple-500/10 background, rounded
- **Badges:**
  - Employment type: Custom colored (emerald for full-time, purple for internship, amber for contract, blue for part-time)
  - Relevance: Green/amber/grey backgrounds with specific classes
  - Duration: `variant="outline"`, text-[11px], font-semibold
- **Timeline dots:** w-2 h-2, rounded-full, muted-foreground/40 opacity
- **Timeline line:** w-px, bg-border
- **Role title:** text-xs font-semibold
- **Company:** text-[11px], muted-foreground
- **Duration text:** text-[11px], font-medium, emerald-600
- **Gap indicator:** amber-300/700 lines with amber badge pill
- Spacing: `space-y-0` for timeline (compact), `py-1.5` per role

---

### 8. **EducationPanel.tsx** - Education Qualifications

**Visual Structure:**
- **Header with Icon + Title + Stat Badges:**
  - GraduationCap icon in score-education color
  - Right-aligned badges: JD Match count, Relevant count, Gap count
- **Education Match Score Bar:**
  - Large percentage (text-xl font-bold)
  - Score quality badge (Strong/Good/Partial/Weak)
  - Helpful text: "AI estimated · X of Y useful"
  - Visual progress bar (score-education color)
  - Scale indicators below (Weak → Strong)
- **Qualifications List (first 4):**
  - Per qualification:
    - Icon based on degree type (Award/GraduationCap/BookOpen/School)
    - Degree + Institution
    - Year badge (colors: emerald if ≤3 yrs old, amber if 5+ yrs, grey otherwise)
    - Education rank badge (Research/Specialised/Ranked)
    - JD Relevance badge
  - "+X more" text for overflow
- **Education Gaps Section:**
  - Hiring risk warning (AlertTriangle icon, destructive red)
  - Per gap: Text + Critical/Preferred severity badge
- **Footer:**
  - Certifications count
  - "See full detail" toggle

**Styling Approach:**
- **Header Icon:** w-6 h-6, score-education color background
- **Badges:**
  - Stat badges: text-[11px], custom relevance classes
  - Score label: Custom color classes (emerald/blue/amber/red)
  - Year badge: Colors based on age (emerald/amber/grey)
  - Rank badge: Custom colors per level (purple/emerald/blue)
  - Relevance badge: text-[11px], custom classes
- **Education icon:** h-3.5 w-3.5, different colors based on relevance (low-rel gets opacity-40)
- **Degree text:** text-xs font-medium (text-muted-foreground if low-rel)
- **Institution:** text-[11px], muted-foreground
- **Progress bar:** h-1.5, bg-score-education
- **Gap item:** px-2.5 py-1.5, rounded-md, custom red/amber backgrounds
- **Certifications list:** Flex wrap gap-1, simple badges
- Spacing: `space-y-1` for qualifications list, `space-y-1.5` for gaps

---

## CROSS-COMPONENT ANALYSIS

### Font Sizes Summary:
| Context | Size | Weight | Usage |
|---------|------|--------|-------|
| Sheet Title | text-lg | — | Candidate name |
| Section Headers | text-sm | font-medium | Panel titles in cards |
| Card Headings | text-xs | font-semibold | "Experience", "Education" |
| Item Titles | text-xs | font-semibold | Role titles, degree names |
| Item Text | text-sm | — | Role descriptions, skill names |
| Supporting Text | text-[11px] | — | Company, institution, date |
| Mini Labels | text-xs | font-medium | "Summary", section subtitles |
| Small Labels | text-[11px] | font-medium | Badge content, duration pills |
| Large Numbers | text-2xl | font-semibold | Overall score, skill score |
| Education Score | text-xl | font-bold | Education match % |

### Badge Usage Consistency Issues:
1. **ExperiencePanel** uses custom inline styles for badges (`className="${role.empType.cls}"`) instead of variant system
2. **EducationPanel** uses custom inline classes for severity badges instead of variant system
3. **SkillsDetailPanel** mixes `variant="secondary"` and `variant="outline"`
4. **Other panels** use Badge variant system consistently

### Color System Usage:
- **Success/Positive:** emerald-500, emerald-600 (matched items, strengths, JD relevant)
- **Warning/Caution:** amber-500, amber-600, amber-700 (gaps, old education, caution)
- **Destructive/Negative:** red-400, red-500, red-600 (missing items, gaps)
- **Secondary:** blue-500, blue-600 (education rank)
- **Tertiary:** purple-500, purple-600 (research, internship)
- **Neutral:** muted-foreground, border, muted colors

### Visual Inconsistencies:
1. **Card styling:** StrengthsGapsPanel, SkillsDetailPanel, JDAlignedPanel use `Card` component; ExperiencePanel and EducationPanel use custom `rounded-lg border border-border bg-card`
2. **Header layout:** ExperiencePanel and EducationPanel have icon + title in a row, others have title in CardHeader
3. **Badge styling:** Inconsistent use of `variant="outline"` vs custom classes
4. **Icon placement:** Different approaches to icon sizing and coloring
5. **Spacing:** Card-based panels use `space-y-4` in content, custom panels use `space-y-3`

---

This is the current state. The components are functional but show signs of evolving incrementally with some inconsistencies in styling approach and structure.
